verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents programmatic domain registration through its REST API. A dedicated register-a-domain guide covers a dryRun pre-flight check and an Idempotency-Key header that stops a retry from registering or charging twice, both well suited to a deploy script. The evidence does not show documented calls for setting registrant contacts or for setting registry nameservers during registration; the NS records in the DNS CRUD and the Cloudflare nameserver repointing are adjacent features. Missing for 10: documented contact-setting calls, documented nameserver assignment at or after registration, independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end scripted registration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register a domain end to end via the API — purchase, contacts, and nameservers in documented calls, so registration can be part of a deploy script

citations.quote: Register, renew, and transfer-in domain names programmatically
A clean REST/JSON API to register, renew, transfer and fully manage domains

a retry within 24h replays the original result instead of registering (or charging) twice.
